Station Notes - Alpine Twp / Comstock Park (MI) 
 
 
04/06/2023: Station Maintenance:                                         [1030] 
 
            - site maintenance, including: 
               - installed canopy leaf wetness sensor: 
                  - 150-ft south of station in apple canopy 
               - checked anemometer (bearings good) 
               - checked battery (13.4 V) 
               - checked pyranometer (adjusted mount / level) 
               - checked solar panel (23.0 V) 
               - checked tipping-bucket rain gauge (good) 
               - checked wind vane (properly aligned) 
               - checked / cleaned battery terminals  
               - cleaned atmp/relh sensor and radiation shield 
               - tested leaf wetness [canopy] (good) 
               - tested leaf wetness [standard] (good)

03/22/2019: Logger Setup                                                 [1430] 
 
            - Loaded MAWN Program: acp-bssd 
                                      acp => Station ID (alpine) 
                                        b => CR1000/MI (Logger/Site) 
                                        s => SDI-12 [CS650] (Soil Moisture) 
                                        s => SDI-12 [HygroVue10] (Temp/RH) 
                                        d => LWS-L (Leaf Wetness) [no canopy] 
 
            - Now able to collect raw weather data.
